paragraphs: Autura sells software to the people who handle towing on public roads, from the officers and dispatchers who order a tow to the impound teams who store and release the vehicle. The company says it supplies towing management and unclaimed vehicle auction software to public safety agency leaders and towing and recovery business owners.

On the agency side, the product handles tow requests and rotation, and Autura says it gives agencies complete control over their towing program. Impound work is pulled into a single compliant system covering storage lookup, regulated fees, and lien and notification workflows. Lien handling uses state-approved lien search and notification capabilities. A separate marketplace covers how impound facilities sell unclaimed vehicles. Agencies can also see private tows logged in their jurisdiction.

The company took its current shape after a 2024 merger with TRAXERO and other acquisitions. It says many of its team members are former tow operators, impound managers, law enforcement officers, and telecommunicators. Its stated reason for the work is roadside safety.

quote.text: Fewer minutes on the roadside means fewer lives at risk.
